“Verifying exposed” is a macOS security check. The system log confirms that `syspolicyd` assessed the `exposed` executable through Gatekeeper. Command-line programs undergo these checks too; the window comes from macOS, rather than your Rust application.

Apple says macOS checks software for known malicious content when first opened, regardless of how it arrived. Rebuilding changes the executable and may prompt a fresh assessment. ([Apple’s Gatekeeper documentation](https://support.apple.com/guide/security/gatekeeper-and-runtime-protection-sec5599b66df/web))

This is separate from the earlier `__eh_frame` linker warning.
